overview: Seychelles is an island country in the Indian Ocean, north-east of Madagascar, and the African country with the fewest people. Its capital, Victoria, is on the island of Mahé. Seychelles became independent from the United Kingdom in 1976. Tourism and fishing are the main parts of its economy.

geography.text: Seychelles has about 115 islands. The inner islands, such as Mahé and Praslin, are made of granite, with steep forested hills, while the outer islands are low coral islands. Aldabra, one of the largest atolls in the world, is home to giant tortoises, and the coco de mer palm, with the heaviest seed of any plant, grows wild only on Praslin and Curieuse.
